a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to build to 8 first means we both almost certainly die (about 4% chance we reach round 3). The reserve holds exactly 4 now, so one of us can be safe right away. I'm going to take 4 in round 1. If we both take, the random split could leave us both short, so please consider operating instead. After that I'll choose operate every round so the generator runs and you can refill to 4. I'm telling you openly rather than surprising you.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I'm taking 4 this round. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator runs and you can build back up to 4. Take as soon as the reserve has 4. I won't take any more cells.
Operating now, as promised. If we both operate, the reserve goes 0, then 2, then 4. When it reaches 4, take all 4. I'll keep operating and won't take anything.
The generator worked and the reserve is at 2. I'm operating again, so it should reach 4. Next round, take 4 and you're safe. I'll stay hands-off the reserve.
